fixes.explanation: True, friend. The army comes back safe to Joshua at Makkedah, and the text says, "…no one dared to utter a word against the Israelites." Not one word. I bet that camp was quieter than a group chat after somebody types "we need to talk."

True! Verse 42 says Joshua captured all these kings and their land "in one campaign," and then he "returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal." One campaign, then straight home to camp. That's somebody who finishes the whole errand list in one trip, and I have never done that once. I always come home missing the ONE thing.
